source_contract.cplus: arXiv:2601.23162 Discussion v defines C+ as the sum over causal structures A_v^(sigma_a sigma_b).
source_contract.cminus: The same discussion defines the co-causal vertex C- as the sum over A_v^(-sigma_a sigma_b).
source_contract.decomposition: The paper states EPRL = C+ + C- + noncausal, with 992 of 1024 independent wedge-sign configurations noncausal.
source_contract.minimal_spin_edge_factor: At j=1/2 the leading scalar branch factor on an internal edge is -kappa_ab; replacing kappa by -kappa multiplies each internal-edge leading factor by -1.
source_contract.scope: Audit only leading scalar sign cancellation on K3/K4/K5 collapse strata. Full angular/intertwiner residues and distribution extensions remain separate.

scope_rule: PASS demonstrates that adding the source co-causal vertex removes the triangle scalar sign obstruction but not the total K5 obstruction; the full EPRL cancellation at K5 uses noncausal wedge-sign sectors. It does not prove full tensor divergence or rule out a separately renormalized causal+co-causal model.
